The polling interval is set by `fetch_reads_debounce_timeout` (deprecated). * `non_polling`: The backend is signaled when a partition has new data, so Redpanda does not need to repeatedly read from every partition in the fetch. By introducing this delay, Redpanda can accumulate more data before processing, leading to fewer fetch operations and returning larger amounts of data. However, Redpanda will log a warning on start-up with a list of any topics that have fewer replicas than this minimum. For example, you might see a message such as `Topic X has a replication factor less than specified minimum: 1 < 3`.

     redpanda │ INFO  2026-10-29 19:58:21,173 [shard 0:main] main - application.cc:852 - redpanda.storage_ignore_timestamps_in_future_sec:{nullopt}	- The maximum number of seconds that a record's timestamp can be ahead of a Redpanda broker's clock and still be used when deciding whether to clean up the record for data retention. This property makes possible the timely cleanup of records from clients with clocks that are drastically unsynchronized relative to Redpanda. When determining whether to clean up a record with timestamp more than `storage_ignore_timestamps_in_future_sec` seconds ahead of the broker, Redpanda ignores the record's timestamp and instead uses a valid timestamp of another record in the same segment, or (if another record's valid timestamp is unavailable) the timestamp of when the segment file was last modified (mtime). By default, `storage_ignore_timestamps_in_future_sec` is disabled (null). To figure out whether to set `storage_ignore_timestamps_in_future_sec` for your system: . Look for logs with segments that are unexpectedly large and not being cleaned up. . In the logs, search for records with unsynchronized timestamps that are further into the future than tolerable by your data retention and storage settings. For example, timestamps 60 seconds or more into the future can be considered to be too unsynchronized. . If you find unsynchronized timestamps throughout your logs, determine the number of seconds that the timestamps are ahead of their actual time, and set `storage_ignore_timestamps_in_future_sec` to that value so data retention can proceed. . If you only find unsynchronized timestamps that are the result of transient behavior, you can disable `storage_ignore_timestamps_in_future_sec`.

ecommerce-im… │   
ecommerce-im… │   ############################
ecommerce-im… │   # Base stage - commons (кешується окремо)
ecommerce-im… │   ############################
ecommerce-im… │   FROM ${GO_IMAGE} AS base
ecommerce-im… │   
ecommerce-im… │   WORKDIR /src
ecommerce-im… │   
ecommerce-im… │   # Corporate CA certificates (for TLS interception proxy)
ecommerce-im… │   COPY ecommerce-infrastructure/environments/local/certs/ca-certificates.crt /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
ecommerce-im… │   
ecommerce-im… │   ENV GOPROXY=https://proxy.golang.org,direct
ecommerce-im… │   ENV GONOSUMCHECK=*
ecommerce-im… │   ENV GOSUMDB=off
ecommerce-im… │   
ecommerce-im… │   ARG COMMONS_DIR=ecommerce-commons
ecommerce-im… │   
ecommerce-im… │   # Commons копіюється один раз і кешується
ecommerce-im… │   COPY ${COMMONS_DIR}/go.mod ${COMMONS_DIR}/go.sum ./${COMMONS_DIR}/
ecommerce-im… │   COPY ${COMMONS_DIR}/pkg ./${COMMONS_DIR}/pkg
ecommerce-im… │   
ecommerce-im… │   ############################
ecommerce-im… │   # Dependencies stage
ecommerce-im… │   ############################
ecommerce-im… │   FROM base AS deps
ecommerce-im… │   
ecommerce-im… │   ARG SERVICE_DIR=service-dir
ecommerce-im… │   ARG COMMONS_DIR
ecommerce-im… │   # API_DEPS - space separated list of API dependency directories (e.g. "ecommerce-catalog-service-api")
ecommerce-im… │   ARG API_DEPS=""
ecommerce-im… │   
ecommerce-im… │   # Копіюємо go.mod/go.sum для кешу модулів
ecommerce-im… │   COPY ${SERVICE_DIR}/go.mod ${SERVICE_DIR}/go.sum ./svc/
ecommerce-im… │   
ecommerce-im… │   # Копіюємо всі API залежності (вони потрібні для go.work)
ecommerce-im… │   # Копіюємо ввесь контекст щоб мати доступ до API модулів
ecommerce-im… │   COPY . /tmp/context/
ecommerce-im… │   
ecommerce-im… │   # Створюємо go.work для локальної розробки з усіма залежностями
ecommerce-im… │   WORKDIR /src
ecommerce-im… │   RUN set -e && \
ecommerce-im… │       echo "=== Docker context contents ===" && \
ecommerce-im… │       ls -la /tmp/context/ && \
ecommerce-im… │       echo "===============================" && \
ecommerce-im… │       go work init && \
ecommerce-im… │       go work use ./${COMMONS_DIR} ./svc && \
ecommerce-im… │       for api_dep in ${API_DEPS}; do \
ecommerce-im… │           if [ -d "/tmp/context/${api_dep}" ]; then \
ecommerce-im… │               echo "Adding API dependency: ${api_dep}"; \
ecommerce-im… │               cp -r "/tmp/context/${api_dep}" "/src/${api_dep}"; \
ecommerce-im… │               go work use "./${api_dep}"; \
ecommerce-im… │           else \
ecommerce-im… │               echo "ERROR: API dependency not found: ${api_dep}" && \
ecommerce-im… │               echo "Make sure it's included in 'only' paths in Tiltfile" && \
ecommerce-im… │               exit 1; \
ecommerce-im… │           fi; \
ecommerce-im… │       done && \
ecommerce-im… │       rm -rf /tmp/context && \
ecommerce-im… │       echo "Final go.work:" && cat go.work
ecommerce-im… │

ecommerce-im… │   
ecommerce-im… │   # Corporate CA certificates

ecommerce-im… │

ecommerce-im… │   ENV GOSUMDB=off

ecommerce-im… │       go install github.com/go-delve/delve/cmd/dlv@v1.27.1
ecommerce-im… │   
ecommerce-im… │   ############################
ecommerce-im… │   # Build stage
ecommerce-im… │   ############################
ecommerce-im… │   FROM deps AS builder
ecommerce-im… │   
ecommerce-im… │   WORKDIR /src
ecommerce-im… │   
ecommerce-im… │   ARG SERVICE_DIR=service-dir
ecommerce-im… │   
ecommerce-im… │   # Копіюємо код сервісу
ecommerce-im… │   COPY ${SERVICE_DIR}/cmd ./svc/cmd
ecommerce-im… │   COPY ${SERVICE_DIR}/internal ./svc/internal
ecommerce-im… │   COPY ${SERVICE_DIR}/db ./svc/db
ecommerce-im… │   
ecommerce-im… │   # Збірка бінарника з debug символами
ecommerce-im… │   WORKDIR /src/svc
ecommerce-im… │   RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/go/pkg/mod \
ecommerce-im… │       --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cache/go-build \
ecommerce-im… │       CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux go build -gcflags="all=-N -l" -v -o /server ./cmd/main.go
ecommerce-im… │   
ecommerce-im… │   ############################
ecommerce-im… │   # Runtime stage
ecommerce-im… │   ############################
ecommerce-im… │   FROM ${RUNTIME_IMAGE} AS release
ecommerce-im… │   
ecommerce-im… │   WORKDIR /
ecommerce-im… │   
ecommerce-im… │   # Копіюємо Delve debugger
ecommerce-im… │   COPY --from=delve /go/bin/dlv /dlv
ecommerce-im… │   
ecommerce-im… │   # Копіюємо бінарник сервісу та конфігурації
ecommerce-im… │   COPY --from=builder /server /server
ecommerce-im… │   COPY --from=builder /src/svc/db/ /db/
ecommerce-im… │   
ecommerce-im… │   # Копіюємо вихідний код для debugging (щоб Delve міг мапити breakpoints)
ecommerce-im… │   # Важливо: шляхи повинні співпадати з тими, що використовувались при компіляції
ecommerce-im… │   COPY --from=builder /src/svc /src/svc
ecommerce-im… │   COPY --from=builder /src/ecommerce-commons /src/ecommerce-commons
ecommerce-im… │   
ecommerce-im… │   # Основний порт сервісу

ecommerce-im… │

ecommerce-im… │   EXPOSE 2345
ecommerce-im… │

ecommerce-im… │   
ecommerce-im… │   ENTRYPOINT ["/server"]
